title: Title card: one character fills the frame and bleeds off it, a reading in the far corner
use: One word reduced to one character as a full-screen beat of a title-card cut or a chapter divider. Not for sentences.

ground.note: ground tone of the card: black, paper white or signal red (style groundTones)

char_size.note: character size x H (bleeds past the frame)

char_top.note: top of the em box x H

ruby_x.note: reading column centre x W; kept right of the character's em box

relations: The character is the only large element; the reading and the label sit in the two corners farthest from its centre.
decoration: Ground tone only; no texture is required.

provenance.corpus: Nocturne Corridor (夜想回廊) experiment: our own original fictional anime set in the shinbo style pack's grammar, first pass and reviewed final
provenance.method: Geometry taken from the final round's HTML/CSS as fractions of W and H; text sizes and colours chosen so the final passed the browser check (contrast with text hidden, ink overlap, collage alpha, off-canvas). All copy is original.
measured: c01: 夜 at 1300px (1.2H) from x 330 (0.17W), top -110 (-0.1H); reading よる 44px vertical at x 1580; the em-box check reported an overlap, the ink check does not
